name: stocklab
description: StockLab: sistema de inventario (React + Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm start --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
